summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a lack of reminder notification and subsequently forgot the scheduled visit.
recommended_action: Verify patient contact information and ensure the automated reminder system is functioning correctly for future appointments.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to the clinic's distance and lack of available transportation options for the morning visit.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth options for routine check-ups or provide information on local medical transport services.

summary: The patient missed the appointment due to financial constraints regarding the consultation fee and inquired about potential discounts for follow-up visits.
recommended_action: Provide the patient with information regarding available payment plans, sliding scale fees, or any existing loyalty discounts for follow-up consultations.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to high fever and body aches, requiring bed rest. They intend to reschedule upon recovery.
recommended_action: Contact the patient in 3-5 days to check on their recovery status and assist with rescheduling the appointment.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to an urgent, mandatory work meeting and requested an evening time slot for future visits.
recommended_action: Reschedule the appointment to an evening slot and update the patient's profile to prioritize after-hours availability.

summary: Patient forgot the appointment due to not receiving an SMS reminder and requested to reschedule.
recommended_action: Verify SMS notification system functionality and reschedule the appointment.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a city bus strike and lack of local transportation options, compounded by the significant distance to the clinic.
recommended_action: Offer telehealth options or assist in coordinating medical transport services for future visits.

summary: Patient was unreachable via phone after three attempts; device was powered off.
recommended_action: Send a follow-up letter or email to request a callback and confirm contact information.

summary: Patient missed the appointment due to a work shift change at their factory and requested Saturday availability.
recommended_action: Update patient profile to prioritize Saturday appointment slots and offer flexible scheduling options.
